title: Community-Impact Scorecard
dataSources: Volunteer shifts (`volunteer:shift`), donations (`donation:gift`), community events (`community:event`), mutual-aid requests (`mutualaid:request`), impact metrics (`impact:metric`).
app: Volunteering and community telemetry — volunteer-hours trackers, donation receipts, mutual-aid request boards, and community-event calendars — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=impact:metric
| bin _time span=1mon
| stats sum(value) as total by metric _time
| stats sum(total) as lifetime by metric
| sort - lifetime
description: Rolls up the tangible outcomes of your service — meals served, trees planted, tutoring hours — into a lifetime impact tally.
value: Concrete impact numbers keep volunteering meaningful and are worth sharing to inspire others.
implementation: Ingest impact metrics into `index=personal`; total each outcome over time.
visualization: Bar chart of lifetime impact by metric.
grandmaExplanation: It adds up the real good you have done — meals served, trees planted — into one inspiring lifetime tally.
